Internal accommodation consists of an entrance hallway, separate living room with solid fuel fire and bay window, dining room with fireplace, kitchen and utility room off the useful, spacious garage. The first floor holds four well-sized bedrooms and a house bathroom with storage solutions throughout the entire property. The second floor offers a attic room with a range of uses. Externally the property boasts views over the valley into Reeth with parking, front and side gardens and a garage. UPVC double glazing and oil central heating are present.
